[1/8, 11:38 PM] PD: My personal mission statement with PaJR is that society and people in general - all over the world are very poorly informed about their own health (for several reasons I won't discuss here)

This generally reflects in how people make choices the world over - particularly in shaping societies and politics. One of the key problems I noticed through my short career is that either there is a profound lack of knowledge in patients or the means to access that knowledge is missing or that the knowledge is too complex to be easily understood (case in point being confused about what endocrinology means)

The simplest and the easiest way patients or people in general understand life is through their own lived experiences a.k.a patient outcomes.

Thus if access to knowledge is simplified and that knowledge is digested to make patients be aware of their own selves and thus tailor their own outcomes accordingly, an absolute revolution will happen in Healthcare.

In short PaJR aims to democratize knowledge, give knowledge and insights into patients' lives themselves such that patients have the ability to make better choices and keep learning about themselves.

Long story short - Knowledge is power.
[1/8, 11:43 PM]PD: Which is why I was probing on very specific details - on what happened in that sna outing, what makes you enjoy your drink etc.

Imagine 50 such similar patients shared data similar to yours and we can eventually democratize this knowledge and then allow you to make your own choices better.

Example - Let us say 50 patients have enjoyed reading Milton Friedman and perhaps you were a past reader of Paul Krugman, then real time PaJR data can suggest to you that 50 patients reported improved blood pressure and overall well being when they were drinking McDowell No. 1 and reading Milton Friedman, perhaps you too may want to consider doing this.

And then when you do this and your BP is consistently in range, then this would be the most specific intervention applied to our patient and not simple generic advise like - Don't drink alcohol or don't smoke or don't eat too much salt etc.

[1/8, 11:45 PM]PD: Someday we hope to have an app which can scan a food plate and tell us the number of micro and macronutrients and the amount of salt, just by pointing a camera at a food plate.

এরপর আবারও স্তালিন ও ঘন্টাখানেক চোখ লেগে আসা।
পাঁচটা নাগাদ উঠে একটু বের হয়ে ফেরার পথে কিঞ্চিত হন্টন। সিঙ্গারা নিয়ে ফিরে এক মগ লাল চা সহযোগে একটা সিঙ্গারা ভক্ষণ।
আবারও স্তালিন, নটার আশেপাশে কারণবারি সহযোগে কিছু নোনতা কাজু। এরপর রাতের খাওয়া হবে: দুটো আটার রুটি ও সম্ভবত এ আলু বড়ি সহযোগে রুই মাছের ঝোল।
